title: Generating from the retrieved sources and citing them

videos.script: Three sources go into the prompt, numbered, each with its section and its date. The question comes last. {{prompt}} The reply comes back with numbers in it. The program turns each number into a link a person can follow. And this reply cites all three sources while the answer, three working days, is in none of its sentences. {{cite}} A citation is a claim, and claims can be checked. Watch a checker catch a true sentence cited to the wrong source, and a sentence no source says. Then run it on the model's own reply: one sentence quoted, four that fail. {{check}} And watch it fail a reply that was right, because the policy wrote the answer as a list. {{relevance}} Next, the instruction to say when the sources are silent. Sent with no sources, the model obeyed this time. This time is all an instruction promises. {{phone}} So the code refuses before the model is ever asked. {{refuse}} Two sources that disagree: given the dates, the model chose the newer. Wherever the rule can be written down, it still goes in code. {{conflict}} And for answers that bind, the clause number goes back into the citation, when the reply quotes. This one paraphrased, and named the wrong party. {{end}}
